```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(glmnet)
library(broom)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(corrplot)
library(scales)
library(nflreadr)

set.seed(123) #for replicability
n_sims <- 10000 #number of simulations                      
alpha_grid <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)   
max_missing_frac <- 0.20            
high_corr_cutoff <- 0.90            

# ---- Data Source ----
# nfl_team_summary.csv was created using publicly available NFL data
# from nflreadr (https://nflreadr.com/) and nflfastR data repositories.
df <- read.csv("C:/Users/treya/Desktop/nfl_team_summary.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

#Preparing The Data
```{r}
#add 
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    games = as.numeric(games),
    wins  = as.numeric(wins),
    win_pct = wins / games,
    turnover_diff = if (all(c("turnovers_forced","turnovers") %in% names(.))) turnovers_forced - turnovers else NA_real_,
    point_diff_per_game = if ("point_diff" %in% names(.)) point_diff / games else NA_real_
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(win_pct))

train <- df %>% filter(season < 2024)
test_2024 <- df %>% filter(season == 2024)

candidate_preds <- c(
  "avg_epa", "success_rate",
  "turnovers", "turnovers_forced", "turnover_diff",
  "def_avg_epa_allowed", "def_success_rate_allowed",
  "yards_per_play", "yards_allowed_per_play",
  "point_diff_per_game"
)
candidate_preds <- intersect(candidate_preds, names(train))

# Drop predictors with too many missing values
na_frac <- sapply(train %>% select(all_of(candidate_preds)), function(x) mean(is.na(x)))
candidate_preds <- names(na_frac[na_frac <= max_missing_frac])

# Quick high-correlation reporting
if(length(candidate_preds) >= 2) {
  corr_tmp <- train %>% select(all_of(candidate_preds)) %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))
  corr_tmp <- cor(corr_tmp, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  high_pairs <- which(abs(corr_tmp) > high_corr_cutoff & abs(corr_tmp) < 1, arr.ind = TRUE)
  if(nrow(high_pairs) > 0) {
    pairs_list <- apply(high_pairs, 1, function(r) paste(rownames(corr_tmp)[r[1]], colnames(corr_tmp)[r[2]], sep = " - "))
  }
}

```


# Correlation Heat Map
```{r}
if(length(candidate_preds) >= 2) {
  num_train <- train %>% select(all_of(candidate_preds)) %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))
  corrm <- cor(num_train, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  corrplot(corrm, method = "color", type = "upper", tl.cex = 0.8, tl.col = "black",
           title = "Train Feature Correlations (2015-2023)", mar = c(0,0,2,0))
}

```


#Offense vs Defense EPA
```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = avg_epa, y = def_avg_epa_allowed)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = point_diff, color = point_diff)) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "#E53935",
    mid = "gray80",
    high = "#43A047",
    name = "Point Diff"
  ) +
  scale_size(range = c(2, 8), guide = "none") + 
  labs(
    title = "Offense vs Defense EPA",
    x = "Offensive EPA (Efficiency)",
    y = "Defensive EPA Allowed"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
df$label_play <- ifelse(
  df$team %in% (
    df %>% arrange(desc(pass_rate)) %>% head(5) %>% pull(team)
  ) |
    df$team %in% (
      df %>% arrange(pass_rate) %>% head(5) %>% pull(team)
    ),
  df$team,
  ""
)
```


#Model Matricies 
```{r}
train_x <- model.matrix(~ . -1, data = train %>% select(all_of(candidate_preds)))
test_x  <- model.matrix(~ . -1, data = test_2024 %>% select(all_of(candidate_preds)))
common_cols <- intersect(colnames(train_x), colnames(test_x))
train_x <- train_x[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]
test_x  <- test_x[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]
y_train <- train$wins
```


#Elastic-Net Alpha Search 
```{r}
cv_results <- list()
for(a in alpha_grid) {
  set.seed(123)
  cv <- cv.glmnet(train_x, y_train, alpha = a, nfolds = 10, family = "gaussian")
  cv_results[[as.character(a)]] <- list(cv = cv, cvm_min = min(cv$cvm))
}
best_alpha <- as.numeric(names(which.min(sapply(cv_results, function(x) x$cvm_min))))
best_cv <- cv_results[[as.character(best_alpha)]]$cv

# Extract coefficients
coef_mat <- as.matrix(coef(best_cv, s = "lambda.min"))
coef_df <- tibble(term = rownames(coef_mat), estimate = as.numeric(coef_mat[,1])) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(estimate)))
```


#Importance of Variables
```{r}
coef_plot_df <- coef_df %>% filter(term != "(Intercept)" & estimate != 0)
p_varimp <- ggplot(coef_plot_df, aes(x = abs(estimate), y = reorder(term, abs(estimate)))) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Regularized Coefficients (abs) - Elastic-net", x = "Abs(coef)", y = "") +
  theme_minimal()
print(p_varimp)
```


#Predict Expected Wins
```{r}
train$pred_wins_raw <- as.numeric(predict(best_cv, newx = train_x, s = "lambda.min"))
test_2024$pred_wins_raw <- as.numeric(predict(best_cv, newx = test_x, s = "lambda.min"))

calib_df <- train %>% mutate(pred_wins_raw = pred_wins_raw)
calibration <- glm(cbind(wins, games - wins) ~ pred_wins_raw, data = calib_df, family = binomial())
prob_pred <- predict(calibration, newdata = data.frame(pred_wins_raw = test_2024$pred_wins_raw), type = "response")
test_2024$game_win_prob <- pmax(pmin(prob_pred, 0.995), 0.005)
test_2024$expected_wins <- test_2024$game_win_prob * test_2024$games
test_2024$coaching_diff <- test_2024$wins - test_2024$expected_wins
```

#Evaluation On 2024 Season
```{r}
mae  <- mean(abs(test_2024$wins - test_2024$expected_wins), na.rm = TRUE)
rmse <- sqrt(mean((test_2024$wins - test_2024$expected_wins)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
r2   <- cor(test_2024$wins, test_2024$expected_wins, use = "complete.obs")^2
```


#Expected vs Actual Wins
```{r}
p_exp_act <- ggplot(test_2024, aes(x = expected_wins, y = wins)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = team), size = 3, max.overlaps = 20) +
  labs(title = "2024 Expected vs Actual Wins", x = "Expected Wins", y = "Actual Wins") +
  theme_minimal()
print(p_exp_act)

cat("2024 performance:\n")
cat(sprintf("MAE: %.3f\nRMSE: %.3f\nRB2: %.3f\n", mae, rmse, r2))
```
